scene: Place: an empty rooftop amphitheater at early morning, low clean sunlight and long soft shadows across a circular practice floor. Activity: she practices a skipping-rope rhythm for a cheering performance, pausing mid-hop with both feet just clear of the floor. Each arm runs visibly from shoulder to elbow to wrist, her right hand gripping one wooden rope handle at her right hip and her left hand gripping the other at her left hip. The rope forms one smooth low arc below her feet. Full-body front three-quarter composition at face level, complete head, hands and feet with clear margins. Outfit: an original adult event-performer costume of opaque crimson petal-shaped sculpted bodice panels with a secure heart neckline, bare shoulders, and a short radiating skirt of overlapping copper-embroidered trapezoid wedges over fitted opaque dance shorts, with soft flat dance shoes. New momentary situation: the skipping hop fans the stiff skirt wedges horizontally, revealing the fitted performance shorts and more upper thigh while all coverage stays secure. One tiny minus-shaped charm on a rope handle.

Place: a quiet apartment breakfast nook at night, warm lamplight indoors with the rest in shadow. Activity: she tastes a freshly steamed dumpling and reacts to its unexpected heat, with raised inner brows and mouth slightly open. She stands in a relaxed sideways lean against the edge of a dining counter, shown from mid-thigh upward in a vertical 2:3 image, camera at face level. Her own right arm bends forward from its shoulder, the right hand holds chopsticks with one steaming dumpling in front of her mouth; her own left forearm extends naturally forward, the left hand supports a small ceramic bowl under it. Outfit: an original opaque deep-teal asymmetrical wrap-shell halter top made from overlapping curved satin panels, a secure deep neckline, bare shoulders and open side waist, paired with fitted plum short culottes whose diagonal waistband forms a single sculpted loop at one hip. No armor or reference jewelry. A tiny minus-shaped ceramic chopstick rest is the only species accent.
